exposure: Pull method of fetal head extraction
Push method of fetal head extraction
cohort: 86 patients experiencing prolonged second stage of labor with deeply impacted fetal heads undergoing cesarean section.
finding: The pull technique for delivering a deeply impacted fetal head during cesarean section had a considerably lower risk of uterine incision extension compared to the push technique.
mod_finding: The pull technique for delivering a deeply impacted fetal head during cesarean section resulted in considerably lower risk of uterine incision extension compared to the push technique.
